annotations.title: Build Same-Chain ERC-20 Dust-to-USDT/USDC Swap Calldata

description: Build unsigned non-custodial SAME-CHAIN swap calldata (exact-amount ERC-20 `approve` + audited KyberSwap/OpenOcean router swap) converting an ERC-20 token into USDT or USDC on the SAME EVM network (`base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, or `avalanche`). Read-only calldata builder: does not sign or broadcast transactions (unlimited free calls; embeds a 1.00% on-chain integrator fee). Returns JSON with `approve_tx`, `swap_tx`, `eip5792_calls`, `estimated_out_usd`, and `provider`. Use this tool when input token and output stablecoin remain on the SAME chain; use `build_cross_chain_consolidation` when bridging between two DIFFERENT chains.

amount_in_raw.description: Exact input amount in atomic base units (wei/smallest integer unit as a decimal string, e.g. `1000000000000000000` for 1.0 18-decimal token).

network.description: Single EVM chain on which both `token_in` and the output `target_stable` reside. Defaults to `base`.

sender.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) that owns `token_in` and will receive the output USDT/USDC.

target_stable.description: Destination stablecoin symbol on the same network (`USDT` or `USDC`). Defaults to `USDT`.

token_in.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 contract address (`0x...`) of the token to swap on `network`.

name: build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep
